name: Cabbage Rolls
description: Traditional cabbage rolls filled with a savory mixture of ground pork, beef, and rice, simmered in tomato juice.

recipeInstructions.text: Boil the cabbage head for 10 minutes to soften the leaves. Drain and let cool.
Chop the onion and fry in lard for 10 minutes until softened.
Mix the cooked onion and lard with ground pork, ground beef, rice, salt, and pepper until well combined.
Peel off cabbage leaves and cut out the thick stem. Place about 1 tablespoon of the meat mixture in the center of each leaf, fold the sides, and roll into a neat package.
Line the bottom of a large pot with a layer of cabbage leaves to prevent burning.
Arrange the cabbage rolls seam-side down in the pot, layering them as needed.
Pour the tomato juice over the cabbage rolls, ensuring they are mostly covered.
Bring the tomato juice to a simmer, then reduce heat and let cook for the entire afternoon (approximately 3 hours).

keywords: cabbage rolls, stuffed cabbage, ground meat, comfort food

_similar.name: Beef and Rice Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty casserole featuring ground beef, sautéed celery and onion, and cooked rice, all baked in a tomato soup sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Sauté celery and onion in butter until soft and tender.
Place rice in a greased 1½ quart casserole dish.
Top the rice with the celery mixture.
Season the ground beef with salt and pepper, then cook in a skillet until browned.
Arrange the cooked beef on top of the celery mixture.
Combine the tomato soup with water and pour over the meat layer.
Bake in a preheated 325°F oven for ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: beef casserole, rice casserole, comfort food

_similar.name: Meatball Pasta Stew
_similar.description: A savory stew with homemade meatballs, pasta, and a rich tomato-based sauce.
recipeIngredient: ¼ to ⅛ cup dry bread crumbs

recipeInstructions.text: Combine hamburger, egg, bread crumbs, onion, salt, mustard, and pepper to make meatballs. Shape into 1-inch balls.
Place meatballs on a greased baking sheet and bake at 350°F for 10 to 15 minutes, or until browned.
In a large pot, cook onion and garlic until tender.
Add flour and stir constantly for 1 minute.
Gradually add beef broth, stirring constantly until boiling.
Add tomato paste, undrained tomatoes, bay leaf, and thyme. Mix well.
Add meatballs, carrots, zucchini, peppers, and parsley. Simmer for 40 minutes.
Add cooked pasta and heat until hot.
Remove bay leaf before serving.

_similar.keywords: meatball stew, pasta stew, tomato-based sauce

_similar.name: Chili Turkey
_similar.description: A hearty chili turkey dish made with ground turkey, kidney beans, and whole wheat spaghetti.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a large heavy pot over medium heat. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until it starts to brown, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the turkey and cook, stirring to coarsely crumble until no longer pink, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Stir in chili powder, tomato paste, broth, cinnamon, cumin, salt, coriander, and oregano. Bring to a simmer.
Partially cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until the meat is tender and the broth is slightly thickened.
Meanwhile, pour the beans (with juice) into a microwaveable bowl. Microwave on high for 1 to 2 minutes or until heated through. Drain and cover to keep warm.
Cook the pasta as directed.
Place pasta on a plate, ladle chili over pasta, and top with beans, then with cheese.

_similar.keywords: chili turkey, ground turkey, kidney beans, whole wheat spaghetti

_similar.name: Hawaiian Meatballs
_similar.description: A Hawaiian-inspired meatball recipe with a sweet and sour sauce, cooked in a pan and finished in the oven.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix the meat mixture together and shape into balls.
Dredge the meatballs in flour and brown in shortening on both sides.
Remove the meatballs from the pan and set aside.
Mix the dry sauce ingredients well, then stir in the wet ingredients.
Stir the sauce mixture into the fat in the pan and cook until thick and bubbly.
Return the meatballs to the pan, cover, and put in the oven to cook for ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: Hawaiian meatballs, sweet and sour sauce, oven-finished

_similar.name: Sloppy Joe Squares
_similar.description: A layered casserole featuring a sloppy joe beef mixture between two layers of crescent roll dough, topped with mozzarella cheese and baked until golden brown.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the beef, onions, and spices in a skillet over medium heat until the meat is no longer red.
Blend in flour to thicken the mixture.
Add 1¼ cups water, ketchup, and Worcestershire sauce. Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.
Preheat oven to 350°F and line a 9×13 inch pan with 1 package of crescent rolls.
Spread the beef mixture evenly over the layer of rolls.
Top the beef mixture with mozzarella cheese.
Cover with the second package of crescent dinner rolls, ensuring the dough touches the edges of the pan.
Bake at 350°F until the crescent rolls are browned.
Serve with a salad.

_similar.keywords: sloppy joe, casserole, crescent rolls, beef
